- [LCON.6.5] **Conformance is correctness only.** Runtime A at 10 ms and runtime B
  at 100 ms can both conform.
gap_reason: The tie is DOCUMENTARY, not verifying. The fixture compiles a minimal rule so the catalogue has an entry against this id; its own scenario says so ("meta-statement … compile_ok of a minimal rule documents the meta entry"). It does not drive the property the clause states, so under [STYL.5.10.8] a green tie here would read as coverage it does not provide. The tie is kept rather than deleted because spec_crossref seeds conformance from the fixture-name convention and would re-add it; the gap is asserted so the clause reads honestly in the coverage report instead.
